best_idea: Take the item into the hand as an optimistic removal with a snapshot of its origin, and on the server's deny restore that snapshot instead of guessing where it belongs.
decision_why: Keep the snapshot-and-rollback shape for equip and loot moves, but use explicit held/sent/placed states keyed by a request id instead of two boolean flags, and let only the server's update clear a sent move.
acceptance: A player drags a helmet onto an empty helm slot; it shows as in hand, then equips when the server confirms; if the server denies (slot taken by a race), the helmet returns to the bag slot it came from within one frame, and a server test asserts exactly one copy of the item at every step.
